info.headline: Red Alert: Extremely Heavy Rainfall and Flash Floods in Wayanad
info.description: Extremely heavy rainfall exceeding 204 mm in 24 hours with high risk of sudden water level rise in river basins and inundation of low-lying settlements across Wayanad district.
info.instruction: Move immediately to designated concrete relief shelters on higher ground. Avoid crossing waterlogged bridges and mountain roads. Keep drinking water and emergency torches accessible.
